visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women stand face-to-face against a plain white wall. One has long brown hair and wears a black corduroy jacket; the other has short dark hair and wears a patterned grey and white cardigan over a white shirt. Large yellow and pink text overlays cover their torsos. (2) The women attempt to lean in for a kiss but hesitate, squinting their eyes and puckering their lips with awkward smiles. The woman in the black jacket pulls back and laughs, while variety text bubbles appear around them to highlight the 'ew' and 'giggle' moments. (3) A close-up shot focuses on their faces as they slowly move closer again with their eyes closed. Their noses brush against each other. (4) The scene cuts to them laughing hysterically in a living room setting with a light grey sofa visible behind them. The woman in the black jacket bends over laughing, while the other gestures excitedly. (5) After several more attempts with similar awkward leaning and close-up framing, they finally make contact with their lips. Immediately, they both recoil with extreme facial expressions of mock disgust and intense laughter, one falling onto the sofa while the other jumps back, covering her mouth. The video concludes with a black and white filter and centered white text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice introduces the 'sister kiss challenge' over a bouncy, upbeat electronic comedy BGM. (2) A 'pop' SFX triggers as the speakers lean in. Sounds of suppressed giggling and sharp indrawn breaths follow. (3) Laughter erupts as they fail the first attempt, followed by high-pitched female commentary about only touching noses. (4) A rhythmic 'ding' SFX sounds during a second close-up attempt, accompanied by low-volume murmuring. (5) A calm off-screen female voice counts down '3, 2, 1' with clear articulation. (6) A sharp 'kiss' sound effect or 'pop' triggers, immediately followed by loud, explosive female screaming and continuous, rapid-fire laughter. The BGM remains energetic throughout. (7) Final segment features multiple voices laughing and shouting 'so disgusting' in a playful, high-valence tone. A hard cut ends the audio with a final off-screen comment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by showing a humorous and awkward 'kiss challenge' between two close friends, emphasizing their chemistry and the funny reality of failing a trend.
